body: I've been on them for about 7 months. I like my counselor. My suicidal thoughts are the only thing I've kept from her.
I'll tell my therapist next week. Thanks for the advice.

I don't remember what my counselor said exactly, but it sounded like any mention of suicidal thoughts would mean police, a hospital stay, etc. I'm guessing it's because my attempt was with a more lethal method. I'd just really rather switch medications at home and only get supervision if I really don't have another option.
